verdict.rationale: Synctera is a hosted banking-as-a-service platform. Asking whether its core can be self-hosted is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions self-hosting, on-premise deployment, or downloadable distributions; the docs describe only hosted APIs and a vendor-run sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
